title: Student Grade Calculator

content.problemStatement:
Based on the given marks, print the corresponding grade according to the following conditions
Given a particular marks, a grade is calculated as per the following table:
Score          Grade
1. marks>=91     A
2. 76<=marks<=90 B
3. 61<=marks<=75 C
4. marks<=60     D

solution.approach: Assign grades based on marks: >=91 -> Grade A, 76-90 -> Grade B, 61-75 -> Grade C, <=60 -> Grade D.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Evaluate score thresholds in descending order to output the corresponding grade.

hints: Use if-else ladder starting with the highest mark range.
Follow the table criteria for Grade B, Grade C, Grade D.
learningObjectives: Order conditions effectively in range testing.
